Class 7A playoff preview: Yorkville in Opening Round
Yorkville hosts Palatine in a Class 7A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Yorkville will win 29-21.
Yorkville hosts Palatine in a Class 7A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Yorkville will win 29-21.
The top 16 seeds in the 48-team Class 7A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 7 p.m.: No. 34 Palatine (4-5) at No. 31 Yorkville (4-5) (Yorkville 29, Palatine 21)
Game Capsules
No. 34 Palatine (4-5) at No. 31 Yorkville (4-5)
Palatine travels to Yorkville in the Class 7A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 2 Hersey (9-0) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7 p.m. Friday.
#31 Yorkville (4-5)
Yorkville (4-5) is the No. 31 seed in the 48-team Class 7A field and hosts No. 34 Palatine in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Yorkville went 4-5 overall and 1-4 in Southwest Prairie (West), scoring 199 points and allowing 173, an average margin of +2.9 a game.
Yorkville went 7-3 last season, including 0-1 in playoffs. Yorkville has reached the playoffs in six of the last 10 seasons.
